outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Duffield is a vibrant village steeped in history and surrounded by attractive countryside. Among its key landmarks is the National Trust site of Duffield Castle, alongside the poignant Duffield War Memorial, both of which highlight the area's rich heritage. The village is also home to Eyes Meadow, a popular local landmark providing expansive green space for recreation and outdoor pursuits. Furthermore, Duffield Library functions as an important community facility, serving as a central hub for reading, learning, and local engagement.

Alongside these historic and recreational spaces, the village is well supported by local health services tailored to the needs of the population. NHS general practice services in Duffield are provided from Appletree Medical Practice, delivering core medical care to local residents. Combined with its public amenities, picturesque surroundings, and strong civic identity, Duffield continues to offer a welcoming environment for all who live in and visit the area.

Pharmacy First provides another way for eligible patients to seek help for certain common health conditions. A pharmacist can assess symptoms, consider relevant medicines and medical history, and explain the most appropriate next step. Depending on the clinical assessment, this may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby in Derby. Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby is approximately 7.6 km in a straight line from Duffield.
